pitch_two_minutes.text: Picture a salon owner at nine in the morning. Her first client of the day books online, and then never shows up. The chair sits empty for an hour, and she has already paid for the stylist. Salons, physio clinics and fitness studios lose bookings to no shows and to last minute cancellations. Owners in our reviews describe the old way: chasing clients by phone, one call at a time. Example Booking Software is online booking built for them. Clients book from your website, your Instagram profile or your Google listing. They pay a deposit when they book, and you set your own no-show rule. Reminder texts and emails go out before every visit, so clients remember without anyone picking up the phone. Businesses that turned on deposits cut no shows by about 67 percent. One owner wrote in a review that deposits paid for the subscription in the first week. Other customers say the same thing in their reviews. Fewer no shows, fewer phone calls, and a front desk with time again. Clinics and studios use it the same way, for appointments and for classes. A studio owner wrote that clients pay a deposit to hold a spot in a class. Reminders go out on their own, so nobody on your team has to remember to send them. One owner wrote that clients now book at night, when the business is closed. Your front desk stops chasing people by phone. And you stop paying for empty chairs. Today about 2,400 paying businesses run their bookings this way. If no shows cost you money, let me show you your own booking page with deposits turned on. The demo takes 15 minutes. Would Thursday or Friday suit you for that demo?
